description.text: "This program requires students to master international economics's theory and method, grasp the basic knowledge and skill of international commecial activites, understand the development of international economics and international trade thoery, and can skillfully conduct business activities by applying international rule and foreign languages. Graduates can become business representatives for international business activities,international business engineer and senior management personnel of internationalized operation in international firms, oriented enterprizes and foreign-owned company. Major Courses: Management Thoery, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, International Economics, Financial Administration, International Marketing, International Finance, International Trade Law, Currency Banking, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"

duration.text: The International Business at Qingdao University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK Band 3 or above for Chinese Language Program, and Band 6 or above for other majors. 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in both English and Chinese and be certified by notarization. 5. High school academic transcript Both in English and Chinese 6. Certificate of employment Applicants who have a job should provide certificate of employment, no need for applicants who haven\'t work. Certificate should be written in English and Chinese. 7. Resume Written in Chinese and in English

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 to 60 years old; 2. Be in good health condition 3. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 4. HSK level 6 or above 5. Pass the entrance examination (have to apply with the passport in the international students office at July 11th.for knowing the place of exam)
